seeing-red.description: Adds red dragon tasks to Konar, Nieve and Duradel.

watch-the-birdie.description: Adds aviansie tasks to Chaeldar, Nieve, Duradel, Konar and Krystilia. Unlock requires 60 Agility or Strength.

hot-stuff.description: Adds TzHaar tasks to Chaeldar, Nieve and Duradel, with a Jad option. Zuk is offered after your first Zuk kill.

like-a-boss.description: Adds dedicated boss assignments to Nieve, Duradel, Konar and Krystilia.

reptile-got-ripped.description: Adds lizardmen tasks to Chaeldar, Nieve, Duradel and Konar; shamans can count where compatible.

stop-the-wyvern.description: Removes Fossil Island wyvern tasks without using a block slot. Skeletal wyverns and your current task are unaffected.

basilocked.description: Adds basilisk tasks to Nieve, Duradel and Konar. Knights still need quest access and a compatible task location.

vampyres.description: Adds vampyre tasks to Chaeldar, Nieve, Duradel and Konar. Mortimer's Venators do not need this reward.

wildy-more.description: Adds jellies, dust devils, nechryaels and abyssal demons to Krystilia's Wilderness pool. Free to toggle in game.

warped-reality.description: Adds warped creature tasks to Chaeldar, Nieve, Duradel and Konar after The Path of Glouphrie.

lured-in.description: Adds aquanite tasks to Nieve and Duradel.

wings-spread.description: Adds gryphon tasks to Nieve and Duradel after Troubled Tortugans.

heavy-frost.description: Raises frost dragon task weight from 5 to 8 for Nieve and Duradel. This increases odds; it does not unlock the task.
